input.subject: Fee statement and payment details request – [PERSON_2] (Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1])
input.body:
Dear Student Finance team,

I am writing on behalf of the family of [PERSON_2] (Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1]), who is expected to begin the MSc programme in January 2027. CarryPay assists the family with paying university fees.

Please confirm that [PERSON_2] is a confirmed offer-holder for this programme.

Could you please provide, in one reply:

1. The official fee statement for the first term, including tuition and accommodation fees, any deposit required, the amounts due in GBP, and the deadline by which each payment must be received.
2. Your bank account details on official letterhead for payment by bank transfer: account name, account number, sort code and/or IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, and bank name and address.
3. The exact payment reference your bank requires (for example the Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1]).
4. Confirmation of whether you accept card payments, and any surcharge that applies.

If the first-term accommodation invoice will be issued separately or at a later date, please let us know when to expect it.

Thank you.
